title: Community-Preserving Graph Partitioning for Distributed Knowledge Graphs: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Partitioning massive citation graphs across distributed workers often breaks dense local citation motifs. We design an edge-cut minimizing partitioning objective based on balanced modularity maximization. Evaluated on 16-node compute clusters, our partitioner reduces cross-node message exchanges by 56.2% during GraphRAG retrieval. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 3.4x and a verified task accuracy of 94.1% with mean execution latency of 9.6ms.
